title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 83
paragraphs: In later time, after these events, many of the Plataeans also found chests of gold, silver, and other treasures. Moreover, afterwards the following was seen concerning the bodies here, after the flesh had been stripped from the bones: the Plataeans had gathered the bones all into one place, and there was found a skull with no suture but all of one bone, and also a jawbone (the upper part of the jaw) which had teeth joined together and all of one bone — both the cutting teeth and the grinding teeth; and there were also seen the bones of a man five cubits tall.
